Set the Keybind for switching between [command missile modes] on player ships. 
See the related [codex] entry for more details.
Enables the Separatists fleet option for new games.

Enables the status effect system if set to true.
Note: Disabling will nerf certain ships/weapons a lot.

Max number of [command missiles] a frigate can fire at once.
(default: 1)

Max number of [command missiles] a destroyer can fire at once.
(default: 2)

Max number of [command missiles] a cruiser can fire at once.
(default: 2)

Max number of [command missiles] a capital ship can fire at once.
(default: 3)

Bonus number of [command missiles] the [ECCM] hullmod provides.
(default: 2)

Bonus number of [command missiles] the [Missile CIC] hullmod provides.
(default: 2)

Max average percentage of armor the repair beam can fix. (default: 0.1)
1.0 = repair armor to full always, even if totally lost.
0.2 = a ship with 30 percent armor can be repaired up to 50 percent, but no higher.
0.0 = no repair all.
